title: Question builder
subject: Arabic
unit: Summer 1: Similar-sounding letters; the four seasons; my mother
source: Seeded from arabic/y4 lesson 17 (Pupil PDF worksheet: question builder)
intro: Lesson 17: The verbal sentence and question words: مَنْ، أَيْنَ، مَتَى. To understand how a verbal sentence starts with a verb and how to ask who, where and when

questions.q: Find the verb: كَتَبَ الطَّالِبُ الدَّرْسَ.
questions.model: Teacher: a verbal sentence begins with the verb. The first word is كَتَبَ, 'he wrote', so this is a verbal sentence.

questions.q: Question builder on the pupil PDF: for three verbal sentences, underline the verb and write a مَنْ، أَيْنَ and مَتَى question with its answer; then ask your partner one aloud.
questions.a: For example: خَرَجَتْ لَيْلَى إِلَى الحَدِيقَةِ فِي المَسَاءِ: مَنْ خَرَجَتْ؟ لَيْلَى. أَيْنَ؟ إِلَى الحَدِيقَةِ. مَتَى؟ فِي المَسَاءِ.
questions.model: Teacher does sentence 1, underlining خَرَجَتْ and writing مَنْ خَرَجَتْ؟ لَيْلَى.

questions.q: turn الوَلَدُ ذَهَبَ into a verbal sentence.
unit check: write one sentence using a season, my mother and a question word.
questions.a: For example: مَتَى تَطْبُخُ أُمِّي فِي الصَّيْفِ؟
